title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions reused by the other schemas. Field names for iRacing data are provisional until the Phase 0 spikes confirm what the SDK provides.

version.description: Protocol version v. Receivers support the current and the previous version.

carNumber.description: Car number as a string of one to three digits, because iRacing allows values like '07'. Car numbers are part of channel names (event.{id}.car.{number}), so nothing else is allowed.

flagName.description: Session flag state as normalised by the agent from iRacing's SessionFlags (spike 3, 2026-10-25). green is derived, not the sim's green bit (which is set only for a few seconds after a green flag): the agent reports green while the session state is Racing and no caution, caution_waving, red or checkered applies. caution is set for the whole full-course caution (the sim's caution or caution-waving bit); caution_waving is set in addition while the caution is waved. one_lap_to_green, green_held, white, checkered, red, yellow (local yellow), yellow_waving, debris, ten_to_go and five_to_go map one to one to the sim's bits. Confirmed in the sim so far: green, caution, caution_waving, one_lap_to_green, green_held.

scope.description: all: every device of the session. class: devices of the listed classes. car: the devices that claimed the listed cars. stewards: the league's stewards only (steward channel).

classes.description: Class ids. Required with scope class, not allowed otherwise.

cars.description: Car numbers. Required with scope car, not allowed otherwise.

condition.description: Fixed set of predicates combined with all, any and not. No scripting.

flag_is.description: True while the snapshot's session.flags contains this flag.

agents_active.description: At least this many agents are active.
